description.zh: 一个编号的格子网格中，1-2 格短暂出现宝藏标记后藏起来，孩子要选出宝藏所在格子的编号。K1-G2 从 2×2、无停顿逐步过渡到 3×3、两处宝藏、藏起来后还要等一等才能作答。训练的是对空间位置的短时记忆与延迟保持。
description.en: A treasure marker briefly appears in 1-2 cells of a numbered grid, then hides; the child picks the number of the cell that held it. K1-G2 goes from a 2x2 grid with no pause up to a 3x3 grid with two treasures and a pause before answering is allowed. What it trains is short-term spatial memory and holding a location through a delay.

designModel.zh: 主轴是格子规模（grid_size）与宝藏数量（treasure_count），配合藏起来到能作答之间的停顿（delay_ms，越长越考验保持能力）。格子编号全程可见，只有宝藏标记闪现，避免把『找编号』和『记位置』混在一起。
designModel.en: The primary axes are grid size (grid_size) and treasure count (treasure_count), paired with the pause between hiding and being allowed to answer (delay_ms — longer pauses test retention harder). Cell numbers stay visible throughout; only the treasure marker flashes, so the task isolates 'remember the position' from 'read the label'.

ageRange.noteZh: K1 2×2 格、无停顿适合 3-4 岁；G2 3×3 格、两处宝藏、停顿 1.5 秒约 7 岁。
ageRange.noteEn: K1's 2x2 grid with no pause suits ages 3-4; G2's 3x3 grid with two treasures and a 1.5s pause suits about age 7.

seriesBoundary.policyZh: 本模块属小精灵系列 · 记忆守护者。训练的是『藏起来后凭记忆定位』，答题前宝藏标记已经消失，且高等级还需再等一下；与 difference-scout（找不同侦探）和 spatial-pattern（空间规律）不同，那两者作答时图形/规律全程可见，训练的是当下的空间比较或推理，不涉及延迟回忆。
seriesBoundary.policyEn: This module belongs to MindSeeds · Memory Guardian. It trains locating something from memory after it disappears — the marker is gone before answering, and higher grades add a further pause. This differs from difference-scout and spatial-pattern, whose figures/patterns stay visible while answering; those train ongoing spatial comparison or reasoning, not delayed recall.

geneReporting.ruleZh: 每次 Attempt 上报 RG.MEMORY.SPATIAL.BASIC，不随等级变化。
geneReporting.ruleEn: Every attempt reports RG.MEMORY.SPATIAL.BASIC, regardless of grade.

difficultyAxes.noteEn: The grid's side length: K1-K2 use 2x2 (4 cells), G1-G2 use 3x3 (9 cells).

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 同时藏起的宝藏格数，G2 起为两处，记住其中一处即可答对。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: How many cells hide a treasure at once; from G2 there are two, and remembering either is enough to answer.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 宝藏藏起来之后、选项能点之前的等待时间，越长越考验记忆保持而非瞬时印象。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: The wait between the treasure hiding and the options becoming clickable; a longer wait tests sustained retention rather than an instant impression.

sessionPolicy.noteZh: 一次 8 题，通过线 75%（6/8）。没有静态题库：generator.js 现生成，玩完立即换一批。
sessionPolicy.noteEn: Eight items per run, passing at 75% (6/8). No static bank: generator.js builds each set and a new one is swapped in when the run ends.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 2×2 格子里记住一处宝藏，藏起来后立刻能选。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Remember one treasure in a 2x2 grid; answer as soon as it hides.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 2×2 格子，藏起来后要等一下才能选。
levelMap.objectiveEn: A 2x2 grid, with a short wait before answering is allowed.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 3×3 更大的格子，选项更多，等待更久。
levelMap.objectiveEn: A bigger 3x3 grid with more options and a longer wait.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 3×3 格子藏两处宝藏，记住其中一处，等待最久后再选。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Two treasures in a 3x3 grid; remember either one, then answer after the longest wait.

statistics.noteZh: optionTypes 区分 treasure（正确格）与 empty_cell（空格干扰），能看出是记错了位置还是随手乱选。
statistics.noteEn: optionTypes separate treasure and empty_cell, showing whether an error was a wrong-position memory or a random guess.
